verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product with documented public endpoints for Search, Contents, Websets and Agent, plus published rate limits and an official JS SDK showing search, answer, streaming and agentic tool-loop usage. A hands-on user independently confirms using the search API, and the docs are machine-readable (llms.txt, .md pages). One user reported a wrong cURL example in 'Get Code', but that is a doc defect, not evidence the API doesn't work. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and fully accurate code samples.
